1. (Currently Amended) A method for generating a superframe preamble for a superframe, the superframe preamble comprising a plurality of symbols, in an orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) network, comprising: for a first one of the symbols, allocating a first set of subcarriers of a carrier to a first broadcast channel, the first set of subcarriers distributed over substantially the entire carrier __and separated from a second set of subcarriers by frequency-division multiplexing__; and for the first one of the symbols, allocating a second set of subcarriers of the carrier to a second broadcast channel __such that the first and second sets of subcarriers are simultaneously transmitted in the first symbol without overlap__.

2. (Currently Amended) The method as set forth in Claim 1, the first set of subcarriers distributed uniformly over substantially the entire carrier __and interlaced with the second set of subcarriers__.

3. (Currently Amended) The method as set forth in Claim 1, the first set of subcarriers distributed non-uniformly over substantially the entire carrier, according to a pre-determined pattern __that differs from the distribution pattern of the second set of subcarriers__.

4. (Currently Amended) The method as set forth in Claim 1, the second set of subcarriers distributed over substantially the entire carrier __in a pattern that is distinct from the first set of subcarriers__.

19. (Currently Amended) A superframe generator in a base station in an OFDM network, comprising a preamble generator operable to generate a superframe preamble comprising a plurality of symbols for a superframe by (i) for a first one of the symbols, allocating a first set of subcarriers of a carrier to a first broadcast channel, the first set of subcarriers distributed over substantially the entire carrier __and separated from a second set of subcarriers by frequency-division multiplexing__, and (ii) for the first one of the symbols, allocating a second set of subcarriers of the carrier to a second broadcast channel __such that the first and second sets of subcarriers are simultaneously transmitted in the first symbol without overlap__.

20. (Currently Amended) The superframe generator as set forth in Claim 19, the first set of subcarriers distributed uniformly over substantially the entire carrier __and interlaced with the second set of subcarriers__.

21. (Currently Amended) The superframe generator as set forth in Claim 19, the first set of subcarriers distributed non-uniformly over substantially the entire carrier, according to a pre-determined pattern __that differs from the distribution pattern of the second set of subcarriers__.
